title: Executable but Unfaithful: Mock Object, Stub, and Assertion Generation by LLMs and Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.14629v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mocking is a foundational practice in unit testing, enabling developers to isolate the code under test by replacing real dependencies with simulated alternatives. Automating the generation of mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions has been a long-standing research goal. However, capture-and-replay approaches rely on recording the runtime behavior of actual dependencies. Evolutionary approaches such as StubCoder overcome this requirement but constrain generation to predefined symbol pools. Large language models (LLMs) and coding agents offer an alternative by generating mocking artifacts from source code without requiring recorded dependency executions or fixed symbol pools. Yet, no systematic study has evaluated their capabilities across all three artifact types.   To address this gap, we construct MockBench, a benchmark comprising 165 mock artifact generation tasks from real-world Java and Python projects, with validated reference

translated_title: 可执行但不可信：基于大语言模型与编码智能体的模拟对象、桩与断言生成
translated_abstract: 模拟是单元测试中的一项基础实践，它使开发者能够通过用模拟替代品替换真实依赖来隔离被测代码。自动化生成模拟对象、桩和模拟断言一直是一个长期的研究目标。然而，捕获-重放方法依赖于记录真实依赖的运行时行为；诸如StubCoder之类的演化方法虽然克服了这一要求，却将生成限制在预定义的符号池中。大语言模型（LLM）和编码智能体提供了一种替代方案：它们可以直接从源代码生成模拟制品，而无需记录依赖的执行轨迹或固定的符号池。然而，目前尚无系统性研究对它们在全部三类制品上的能力进行评估。为填补这一空白，我们构建了MockBench——一个包含来自真实Java和Python项目的165个模拟制品生成任务的基准数据集，并配有经过验证的参考（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个系统性基准MockBench（含165个来自真实Java与Python项目的任务），全面评估了大语言模型与编码智能体生成模拟对象、桩和模拟断言三类制品的能力，并发现其生成的代码虽可执行但往往与真实依赖行为不一致。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MockBench, the first systematic benchmark of 165 real-world Java and Python tasks evaluating LLMs and coding agents on generating all three mocking artifacts (mock objects, stubs, and assertions), revealing that their generated mocks are executable but often unfaithful to actual dependency behavior.
